objective: Review the non-executing dry-run result for the native Verilator option parser boundary and select the smallest next definition step without overstating native parser support.

review_decision.reason: The dry-run result records twelve non-executing preview or rejection commands with expected exits, exposes the expanded future-Verilator spelling for the two static tracked filelist targets, keeps estimate mode separate, shows the coverage_output_equivalence handoff contract, and writes no generated report or artifact as source of truth.
review_decision.weakest_point: There is still no Verilator source tree or parser patch in this repository, and unknown accelerator names are currently rejected by argparse choices before reaching the shared compatibility mapper. The next gate must define the parser stub boundary and validation layer rather than claiming native parser support.

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_stub_boundary_gate
must_define: the smallest parser-stub boundary that can accept --sim-accel sidecar-gpu with paired positive --sim-accel-states and --sim-accel-steps
where unknown accelerator validation belongs: native parser, shared mapper, or explicit compatibility wrapper layer
how parser-stub errors are represented without depending on current argparse-only behavior
the structured handoff fields that the stub must produce or call before any execution
how ordinary Verilator inputs, defines, filelists, top module, and mdir remain visible
how the stub avoids inferring arbitrary source closure, coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, state paths, or report paths
the non-executing tests or fixtures required before any native parser implementation claim
must_not_claim: Verilator source patch landed in this repository

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not a new public CLI or workflow
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
